dossiers.title: Primary matrix function as Hermite interpolant at Jordan data
dossiers.public_source: N. J. Higham, Functions of Matrices: Theory and Computation, SIAM, 2008, Definitions 1.4 and 1.2, Theorem 1.12. Survey: Higham–Al-Mohy, Acta Numerica 2010, Definition 2.2. Public PDF of the Schur–Padé companion: https://eprints.maths.manchester.ac.uk/2067/1/paper.pdf

dossiers.title: Fréchet derivative of f at a diagonalizable matrix as Loewner kernel
dossiers.public_source: Higham 2008, Theorem 3.11 and Corollary 3.12. Classical source: Daleckii–Krein, AMS Transl. Ser. 2 47 (1965). Restatement for diagonalizable (not necessarily Hermitian) matrices with C^1 on the spectrum: Noferini, MIMS EPrint 2016.24, Theorem 2.10, https://eprints.maths.manchester.ac.uk/2462/1/gendk.pdf

dossiers.title: Resolvent identities as Newton difference quotients
dossiers.public_source: Glück, Functional Analysis 1, Prop. 2.2.9 and Example 2.3.2. Two-operator form: Müger, Functional Analysis, Exercise 13.29. Textbook: Kato 1982, Chapter I. Convention (zI-A)^{-1}: Higham 2008, Definition 1.11.

dossiers.title: Cauchy–Dunford integral of the resolvent as master for f(A)
dossiers.public_source: Higham 2008, Definition 1.11 and Theorem 1.12. Higham–Lin, https://eprints.maths.manchester.ac.uk/2067/1/paper.pdf, Definition 3.3. Related contour DD: de Boor, arXiv:math/0502036, §9.

dossiers.title: Fréchet derivative as the off-diagonal block of f of a 2n triangular matrix
dossiers.public_source: R. Mathias, SIAM J. Matrix Anal. Appl. 17 (1996) 610–620, Theorem 2.1. Higham 2008, Theorem 3.6. Al-Mohy–Higham, Theorem 2.1 (Fréchet derivative of the matrix exponential paper).

dossiers.title: Opitz formula: matrix function of the Newton bidiagonal is the DD table
dossiers.public_source: C. de Boor, Divided Differences, Surveys in Approximation Theory 1 (2005) 46–69, arXiv:math/0502036, Proposition 25 and Definition 37. Original: G. Opitz, ZAMM 44 (1964).

dossiers.title: First-order perturbation of a simple eigenvalue via reduced resolvent
dossiers.public_source: A. Greenbaum, R.-C. Li, M. L. Overton, arXiv:1903.00785, Assumption 1 and Theorems 1–3. Kato 1982, Chapters I–II (reduced resolvent, eigenprojector).

dossiers.title: Parlett recurrence on a triangular factor: generic quotient vs block degeneracy
dossiers.public_source: B. N. Parlett, Linear Algebra Appl. 14 (1976) 117–121. Higham–Al-Mohy, Computing matrix functions, Acta Numerica 2010, Algorithms 4.2–4.3, https://eprints.maths.manchester.ac.uk/1451/1/paper8.pdf. Higham 2008, Chapter 9.
